why_it_deserves_further_comparison: Unlike the prior six-swap Spear Spewer trial, replaces the second deleted counter (Pact of Negation) with Harmonic Prodigy; Pact therefore remains to defend decisive turns. Still loses Pyroblast, which is nontrivial.

Retains original key Warhammer flavor through Abaddon, Noise Marine, Keeper, The Lost, and swaps Warhammer Ghyrson plus Blood for the Blood God! in place of original Ruinous/Tempest. However it loses opponent spell theft and printed unconditional double cascade; these are hard costs, not cosmetic.

Two-mana Harmonic has four EXISTING independently source-verified relevant sources: Kessig Flamebreather, Thermo-Alchemist, Vivi Ornitier and Storm-Kiln Artist, whereas Bloodletter is a broader single-turn life-loss multiplier. Their strengths are not interchangeable.
Ghyrson plus Kessig/other exactly-one pings increases incremental life loss, but is three more paid mana and board-dependent. Its Warhammer theme fits better than generic redundancy.

Ob Nixilis converts existing exactly-one all-opponent pings into exiled playable own-library cards and counters, better controlled than Ruinous random opponent library theft in some matchups; it is more creature-removal vulnerable.

Kederekt Parasite is a one-mana opponent-wheel draw punisher, but all such triggers happen after the wheel resolves and are irrelevant to the wheel's own Abaddon cascade check; removing Pyroblast loses immediate blue answers.

Blood for the Blood God! is an eleven-MV 40K payoff discounted by deaths, eight-card draw and eight to EACH opponent, but does NOT inherently cascade, needs board deaths for real payment and discards hand; Call Forth always has two printed cascades even without Abaddon.
Mount Doom generates black/red mana at a life cost and has a paid all-opponent ping; replacing one Mountain loses a basic and damage-free source, which may matter in a self-harming Flame Rift deck.

source_bound_finite_outcomes.case: Kessig + Harmonic, own-turn noncreature cast at prior X=0
source_bound_finite_outcomes.result: Two distinct Kessig triggers, each 1 damage to each of 3 opponents; X rises to 6 after the cast, so the initiating MV3 hand spell did NOT gain retroactive Abaddon cascade. Next qualifying hand cast may.

source_bound_finite_outcomes.case: Thermo + Harmonic, instant/sorcery cast, Thermo ready
source_bound_finite_outcomes.result: Two untap triggers can enable tap before first resolution and between/after each: three activations cause 1 each opponent, X=9; creature must already be able to tap.
Two Wizard triggered damage/counter events, 1 to each opponent each, X=6 and two counters; Vivi's activated once-per-turn {0} mana ability is NOT duplicated.

source_bound_finite_outcomes.case: Storm-Kiln Artist + Harmonic, one real instant cast plus one copy
source_bound_finite_outcomes.result: Two Magecraft events, each doubled, yield four Treasure tokens. Copying doesn't count as a real cast for Kessig or Abaddon.
Two distinct grouped exactly-one life-loss events trigger Ob twice, not six times (one per opponent). Exiled cards are PLAYABLE with actual costs, not automatically cast for free.
If later paired, the one damage to each player triggers Ghyrson for each player; the controller also suffers three total self-damage, limiting safe repeated use.

adverse_scenarios.condition: Opponents remove Kessig/Thermo/Vivi/Storm-Kiln before casting followups
adverse_scenarios.consequence: Harmonic becomes mainly prowess creature with no current trigger doubling; Bloodletter would still amplify Boltwave/Flame Rift/Loyal without requiring these four partners.

adverse_scenarios.condition: Rule of Law/Drannith Magistrate or artifact/graveyard hate already present
adverse_scenarios.consequence: Neither cheap pingers nor extra card exile solves all locks; losing Pyroblast still matters against blue counter magic and may justify keeping old defensive list.

adverse_scenarios.condition: Creature-light table with no recent deaths
adverse_scenarios.consequence: Blood for the Blood God! must pay full eleven mana; old Call Forth costs eight, always has double cascade.
Nightscape Familiar's removed discount would have aided repeated 5+ commander-tax recasts; new synergy pieces need the commander but may work without it only partially.
